events.title: Our Discord link has been fixed
events.summary: The Discord button in the main menu was pointing to an expired invite — sorry if you tried to join and hit a dead end! Here's the new, permanent link: https://discord.gg/HEdtdeyxxs The in-game button will be fixed in the next update. On the server you can report bugs, share clips and screenshots, find people to play with, and tell us what you think — your feedback shapes the game. See you in the dark!

Seeing so many people interested in my game is truly incredible! I want to say a huge **THANK YOU** to everyone who has supported the project, added the game to their wishlist, played the demo, and shared their feedback. events.title: 15,000 Wishlists — Thank You!
events.summary: We just reached 15,000 wishlists on Steam! Seeing this many people waiting for Echo Mates is honestly incredible.Thank you to everyone who wishlisted the game, shared it, left a comment, or followed the development. Your support means a lot and gives me even more motivation to keep pushing the game forward.The demo is getting closer, and I’m excited to show you more very soon.See you in the dark.
